cards.definition: The overall structure and design of a system (प्रणाली की समग्र संरचना)
cards.exampleSentence: The architecture separates ingestion from transformation.

cards.definition: The arrangement of components and their connections (घटकों की संरचनात्मक व्यवस्था)
cards.exampleSentence: The network topology limits how we can scale.

cards.definition: A single, tightly integrated application (एकल विशाल एप्लिकेशन)
cards.exampleSentence: We are slowly breaking the monolith into services.

cards.definition: A small independently deployable service (छोटी स्वतंत्र सेवा)
cards.exampleSentence: Each microservice owns its own data store.

cards.definition: An infrastructure layer managing service-to-service communication (सेवाओं के बीच संचार प्रबंधन परत)
cards.exampleSentence: The service mesh handles retries and encryption.

cards.definition: Based on producing and reacting to events (घटना-आधारित)
cards.exampleSentence: We moved to an event-driven design to decouple vendors.

cards.definition: A pattern where publishers send messages to subscribers via a broker (प्रकाशक-ग्राहक संदेश पैटर्न)
cards.exampleSentence: Pub-sub lets many consumers react to the same event.

cards.definition: Middleware that routes messages between systems (संदेशों को आगे पहुँचाने वाला मध्यस्थ)
cards.exampleSentence: Kafka acts as our message broker.

cards.definition: How far a consumer is behind the latest message (उपभोक्ता का पीछे रह जाना)
cards.exampleSentence: Rising consumer lag means we're falling behind.

cards.definition: A subset of data split for parallel processing (डेटा का हिस्सा)
cards.exampleSentence: Messages with the same key go to the same partition.

cards.definition: Splitting a database into smaller independent parts (डेटाबेस को टुकड़ों में बाँटना)
cards.exampleSentence: Sharding by vendor ID spreads the load evenly.

cards.definition: Copying data across multiple nodes (डेटा की प्रतिलिपि बनाना)
cards.exampleSentence: Replication provides durability if a node fails.

cards.definition: Guarantee that all readers see the same data (डेटा की एकरूपता)
cards.exampleSentence: Strong consistency costs us some latency.

cards.definition: A model where data becomes consistent over time (समय के साथ एकरूप होने वाला मॉडल)
cards.exampleSentence: Reports tolerate eventual consistency of a few seconds.

cards.definition: The guarantee that committed data persists (डेटा के बचे रहने की गारंटी)
cards.exampleSentence: The queue offers durability even if the broker restarts.

cards.definition: The proportion of time a system is operational and accessible (उपलब्धता)
cards.exampleSentence: The design favours availability over strict consistency.

cards.definition: The ability to function despite network splits (नेटवर्क विभाजन में भी चलने की क्षमता)
cards.exampleSentence: Any distributed system must handle partition tolerance.

cards.definition: Principle that you cannot have all of consistency, availability and partition tolerance (कैप सिद्धांत)
cards.exampleSentence: The CAP theorem forces trade-offs in distributed design.

cards.definition: Adding more machines to handle load (मशीनें बढ़ाकर क्षमता बढ़ाना)
cards.exampleSentence: Horizontal scaling suits our stateless workers.

cards.definition: Adding more power to an existing machine (मशीन की शक्ति बढ़ाना)
cards.exampleSentence: Vertical scaling hits a ceiling quickly.

cards.definition: Not retaining information between requests (पिछली स्थिति न रखने वाला)
cards.exampleSentence: Keep the workers stateless so they can scale freely.

cards.definition: Retaining information between requests (स्थिति को सहेजने वाला)
cards.exampleSentence: Stateful services are harder to scale and recover.

cards.definition: A component that distributes traffic across servers (ट्रैफ़िक बाँटने वाला घटक)
cards.exampleSentence: The load balancer removes unhealthy nodes automatically.

cards.definition: Temporary storage for fast data retrieval (तेज़ पहुँच हेतु अस्थायी भंडारण)
cards.exampleSentence: A cache cut read latency by eighty percent.

cards.definition: To mark cached data as no longer valid (कैश डेटा को अमान्य करना)
cards.exampleSentence: We invalidate the cache whenever a price is corrected.

cards.definition: Removal of items from a cache to free space (कैश से डेटा हटाना)
cards.exampleSentence: Poor eviction policy caused frequent misses.

cards.definition: The duration after which data expires (डेटा की वैधता अवधि)
cards.exampleSentence: Set the time-to-live to one hour.

cards.definition: An ordered list of tasks awaiting processing (कतार)
cards.exampleSentence: Failed messages go to a dead-letter queue.

cards.definition: A queue for messages that couldn't be processed (असफल संदेशों की कतार)
cards.exampleSentence: We review the dead-letter queue every morning.

cards.definition: A mechanism to slow producers when consumers are overwhelmed (दबाव नियंत्रण तंत्र)
cards.exampleSentence: Backpressure prevents the queue from overflowing.

cards.definition: Processing data in groups at scheduled intervals (समूहों में डेटा प्रसंस्करण)
cards.exampleSentence: Batch processing suits the nightly vendor files.

cards.definition: Processing data continuously as it arrives (निरंतर डेटा प्रसंस्करण)
cards.exampleSentence: Stream processing gives us near real-time updates.

cards.definition: A series of connected processing stages (चरणबद्ध प्रसंस्करण शृंखला)
cards.exampleSentence: Each stage of the pipeline can be tested separately.

cards.definition: A defined sequence of steps in a process (कार्य-प्रवाह)
cards.exampleSentence: The workflow retries failed steps automatically.

cards.definition: A unique token ensuring a request is processed once (एक बार प्रसंस्करण सुनिश्चित करने वाली कुंजी)
cards.exampleSentence: Attach an idempotency key to every payment request.

cards.definition: Guaranteeing each message is processed one time only (ठीक एक बार प्रसंस्कृत)
cards.exampleSentence: Exactly-once delivery is hard to guarantee end to end.

cards.definition: Guaranteeing delivery but allowing duplicates (कम से कम एक बार)
cards.exampleSentence: At-least-once delivery requires idempotent consumers.

cards.definition: Treated as a single all-or-nothing operation (लेन-देन आधारित)
cards.exampleSentence: The update must be transactional to avoid partial writes.

cards.definition: Indivisible; either fully completes or not at all (अविभाज्य)
cards.exampleSentence: The write is atomic, so no half-saved records appear.

cards.definition: Separation of concurrent operations to avoid interference (समवर्ती कार्यों का पृथक्करण)
cards.exampleSentence: Higher isolation reduces anomalies but costs performance.

cards.definition: Organising data to reduce redundancy (डेटा की अनावश्यक पुनरावृत्ति घटाना)
cards.exampleSentence: Normalisation keeps the reference data consistent.

cards.definition: To add redundancy to data to improve read speed (पढ़ने की गति हेतु डेटा दोहराना)
cards.exampleSentence: We denormalised the table to avoid expensive joins.

cards.definition: A structure that speeds up data lookup (खोज तेज़ करने वाली संरचना)
cards.exampleSentence: Adding an index cut the query from minutes to seconds.

cards.definition: The database's strategy for executing a query (क्वेरी निष्पादन योजना)
cards.exampleSentence: The query plan shows a full table scan.

cards.definition: Moving data or systems from one environment to another (एक व्यवस्था से दूसरी में स्थानांतरण)
cards.exampleSentence: The migration must finish within the weekend window.

cards.definition: Changing a data structure over time without breaking consumers (डेटा संरचना में क्रमिक बदलाव)
cards.exampleSentence: Schema evolution rules prevent breaking changes.

cards.definition: The record of where data came from and how it changed (डेटा की उत्पत्ति और बदलाव का रिकॉर्ड)
cards.exampleSentence: Data lineage helps auditors trace each number.

cards.definition: The accuracy, completeness and reliability of data (डेटा की गुणवत्ता)
cards.exampleSentence: Poor data quality undermines trust in reports.

cards.definition: The authoritative origin of a piece of data (प्रामाणिक डेटा स्रोत)
cards.exampleSentence: The instrument master is the source of truth.

cards.definition: The single, most accurate version of an entity's data (सबसे सटीक एकल रिकॉर्ड)
cards.exampleSentence: We merge vendor data into a golden record.

cards.definition: Core business data shared across systems (मुख्य साझा व्यावसायिक डेटा)
cards.exampleSentence: Master data management removes conflicting copies.

cards.definition: Adding extra information to existing data (डेटा में अतिरिक्त जानकारी जोड़ना)
cards.exampleSentence: Enrichment adds sector and currency to each record.

cards.definition: To convert data to a common standard format (डेटा को मानक रूप में बदलना)
cards.exampleSentence: We normalise vendor formats into one canonical model.

cards.definition: Standard and authoritative (मानक / प्रामाणिक)
cards.exampleSentence: All vendors map to one canonical schema.

cards.definition: To convert data into a format for storage or transmission (डेटा को संग्रहण योग्य रूप देना)
cards.exampleSentence: Avro is used to serialise the messages.

cards.definition: To convert stored data back into objects (संग्रहीत डेटा को वापस वस्तु रूप देना)
cards.exampleSentence: Deserialisation failed due to a missing field.

cards.definition: An entry point that manages access to services (प्रवेश द्वार)
cards.exampleSentence: All external calls pass through the API gateway.

cards.definition: A URL where a service can be accessed (सेवा का पता)
cards.exampleSentence: The endpoint returns data in JSON format.

cards.definition: The amount of data in a request or message (संदेश में डेटा की मात्रा)
cards.exampleSentence: Large payload sizes slow down the queue.

cards.definition: A cap on the number of requests allowed in a period (अनुरोधों की अधिकतम सीमा)
cards.exampleSentence: The vendor's rate limit blocks bulk downloads.

cards.definition: A pattern that stops calls to a failing service (विफल सेवा को कॉल रोकने वाला पैटर्न)
cards.exampleSentence: The circuit breaker opened after five consecutive failures.

cards.definition: Isolation of components so one failure doesn't spread (विफलता को फैलने से रोकने वाला पृथक्करण)
cards.exampleSentence: A bulkhead keeps one vendor's issue from affecting others.

cards.definition: To attempt an operation again after failure (दोबारा प्रयास करना)
cards.exampleSentence: The job retries three times before alerting.

cards.definition: A limit on how long to wait before giving up (प्रतीक्षा की अधिकतम अवधि)
cards.exampleSentence: The timeout was too short for large files.

cards.definition: A periodic signal showing a service is alive (सेवा जीवित होने का संकेत)
cards.exampleSentence: Missing heartbeats triggered the failover.

cards.definition: A test to see if a service is functioning (सेवा की स्थिति की जाँच)
cards.exampleSentence: The health check failed after the memory spike.

cards.definition: Stopping a service after finishing in-progress work (चल रहे काम पूरे कर बंद करना)
cards.exampleSentence: Graceful shutdown prevents half-processed files.

cards.definition: Delay when a function or service starts from idle (निष्क्रिय से शुरू होने में देरी)
cards.exampleSentence: Lambda cold starts affected our response time.

cards.definition: Running code without managing servers (सर्वरलेस)
cards.exampleSentence: Serverless suits spiky, unpredictable workloads.

cards.definition: To package an application with its dependencies (कंटेनर में पैक करना)
cards.exampleSentence: We containerised the parser for consistent deployment.

cards.definition: Automated coordination of services and tasks (सेवाओं का स्वचालित समन्वय)
cards.exampleSentence: Kubernetes handles container orchestration.

cards.definition: Managing infrastructure through versioned configuration files (कोड से इन्फ्रास्ट्रक्चर प्रबंधन)
cards.exampleSentence: Infrastructure as code makes environments reproducible.

cards.definition: Unchangeable after creation (अपरिवर्तनीय)
cards.exampleSentence: We deploy immutable images rather than patching servers.

cards.definition: Existing only for a short time (अल्पकालिक)
cards.exampleSentence: Ephemeral environments are created for each pull request.

cards.definition: Serving multiple customers from one shared system (एक ही सिस्टम से कई ग्राहकों को सेवा देने वाला)
cards.exampleSentence: A multi-tenant design lowers cost per client.

cards.definition: Keeping each customer's data separate (ग्राहकों के डेटा का पृथक्करण)
cards.exampleSentence: Tenant isolation is a strict security requirement.

cards.definition: Granting only the minimum access required (न्यूनतम आवश्यक अधिकार)
cards.exampleSentence: Apply least privilege to all service accounts.

cards.definition: Protecting stored data by encrypting it (संग्रहीत डेटा का एन्क्रिप्शन)
cards.exampleSentence: Encryption at rest is mandatory for client data.

cards.definition: Verifying who a user or system is (पहचान सत्यापन)
cards.exampleSentence: Authentication is handled by the central identity provider.

cards.definition: Determining what an authenticated user may do (अनुमतियों का निर्धारण)
cards.exampleSentence: Authorisation checks happen at every endpoint.

cards.definition: A right to access a particular resource or data (डेटा/संसाधन तक पहुँच का अधिकार)
cards.exampleSentence: Vendor entitlements restrict who can view the data.

cards.definition: To formally inspect records or processes (औपचारिक जाँच करना)
cards.exampleSentence: Auditors will audit our access logs.

cards.definition: A weakness that could be exploited (कमज़ोरी)
cards.exampleSentence: The scan found a critical vulnerability in the library.

cards.definition: The total points where a system could be attacked (हमले के संभावित बिंदु)
cards.exampleSentence: Removing unused endpoints shrinks the attack surface.

cards.definition: Using multiple layers of security (बहु-स्तरीय सुरक्षा)
cards.exampleSentence: Defence in depth means one failure doesn't expose everything.

cards.definition: Systematic comparison of options' benefits and costs (विकल्पों के लाभ-हानि का विश्लेषण)
cards.exampleSentence: The design doc includes a full trade-off analysis.

cards.definition: A written proposal describing a technical approach (तकनीकी योजना दस्तावेज़)
cards.exampleSentence: Please review the design doc before Friday.

cards.definition: A formal evaluation of a proposed design (आर्किटेक्चर की औपचारिक समीक्षा)
cards.exampleSentence: The proposal passed the architecture review.

cards.definition: A quality attribute such as performance or security (कार्यक्षमता के अलावा गुणवत्ता संबंधी आवश्यकता)
cards.exampleSentence: Latency is a key non-functional requirement.

cards.definition: Estimating resources needed for future demand (भविष्य की मांग के अनुसार संसाधन अनुमान)
cards.exampleSentence: Capacity planning showed we need double the storage.

cards.definition: Spare capacity before reaching a limit (उपलब्ध अतिरिक्त क्षमता)
cards.exampleSentence: We have plenty of headroom on the database.

cards.definition: The highest level of demand on a system (अधिकतम भार)
cards.exampleSentence: Peak load occurs between six and eight each morning.

cards.definition: A short, intense period of activity (अल्पकालिक तीव्र गतिविधि)
cards.exampleSentence: The system must absorb bursts of files from many vendors.

cards.definition: The ability to scale resources up and down automatically (मांग के अनुसार घटने-बढ़ने की क्षमता)
cards.exampleSentence: Cloud elasticity keeps costs aligned with usage.

cards.definition: Delivering good value for the money spent (किफ़ायती)
cards.exampleSentence: Spot instances are more cost-efficient for batch jobs.

cards.definition: The amount of resources a system consumes (संसाधन उपयोग का दायरा)
cards.exampleSentence: We reduced the memory footprint by half.

cards.definition: Extra cost or processing required (अतिरिक्त भार)
cards.exampleSentence: The encryption adds minimal overhead.

cards.definition: The state of having many interconnected parts (जटिलता)
cards.exampleSentence: Adding another service increases operational complexity.

cards.definition: Designed more complexly than necessary (आवश्यकता से अधिक जटिल बनाया गया)
cards.exampleSentence: A custom scheduler would be over-engineered here.

cards.definition: Too simple to meet the actual needs (आवश्यकता से कम विकसित)
cards.exampleSentence: The current solution is under-engineered for our scale.

cards.definition: Designed to remain useful as things change (भविष्य के लिए सुरक्षित)
cards.exampleSentence: An open standard makes the design more future-proof.

cards.definition: Dependence on one provider making switching costly (एक प्रदाता पर निर्भरता)
cards.exampleSentence: Proprietary features create vendor lock-in.

cards.definition: The decision whether to develop in-house or purchase (खुद बनाएँ या खरीदें का निर्णय)
cards.exampleSentence: The build versus buy question comes up every year.

cards.definition: The full cost of a system over its lifetime (कुल स्वामित्व लागत)
cards.exampleSentence: Consider total cost of ownership, not just licence fees.

cards.definition: The ability of different systems to work together (विभिन्न प्रणालियों का साथ काम करना)
cards.exampleSentence: Interoperability with legacy systems is essential.

cards.definition: Old but still in use (पुराना पर चालू (विरासती))
cards.exampleSentence: The legacy system has no documentation.

cards.definition: A new project with no existing constraints (बिल्कुल नया प्रोजेक्ट)
cards.exampleSentence: A greenfield build gives us design freedom.

cards.definition: A project that must work within existing systems (मौजूदा प्रणाली के भीतर काम करने वाला प्रोजेक्ट)
cards.exampleSentence: This is a brownfield integration, so compatibility matters.

cards.definition: Gradually replacing a legacy system piece by piece (धीरे-धीरे पुरानी प्रणाली बदलना)
cards.exampleSentence: We're using the strangler pattern to retire the old platform.

cards.definition: Improving code structure without changing behaviour (कोड संरचना सुधार)
cards.exampleSentence: The refactoring reduced the module's complexity.

cards.definition: The degree of dependence between components (घटकों की आपसी निर्भरता)
cards.exampleSentence: Tight coupling made the change risky.

cards.definition: How closely related a module's responsibilities are (मॉड्यूल की जिम्मेदारियों की निकटता)
cards.exampleSentence: High cohesion makes each service easier to understand.

cards.definition: Dividing a system so each part handles a distinct responsibility (ज़िम्मेदारियों का अलग-अलग विभाजन)
cards.exampleSentence: Separation of concerns keeps parsing apart from validation.

cards.definition: Each component should have one reason to change (हर घटक की एक ही ज़िम्मेदारी)
cards.exampleSentence: The class violates single responsibility by doing everything.

cards.definition: Supplying a component's dependencies from outside (निर्भरताओं को बाहर से देना)
cards.exampleSentence: Dependency injection makes the service easier to test.

cards.definition: Treating different types through a common interface (एक इंटरफ़ेस से विभिन्न रूप संभालना)
cards.exampleSentence: Polymorphism lets us add vendors without changing core logic.

cards.definition: A defined way for components to interact (घटकों के बीच संपर्क का निर्धारित तरीका)
cards.exampleSentence: Code against the interface, not the implementation.

cards.definition: A simplified interface to a complex subsystem (जटिल प्रणाली का सरल इंटरफ़ेस)
cards.exampleSentence: A facade hides the messy vendor integrations.

cards.definition: A component that translates between incompatible interfaces (असंगत इंटरफ़ेस के बीच अनुवादक)
cards.exampleSentence: Each vendor has its own adapter to our model.

cards.definition: Choosing an algorithm at runtime from interchangeable options (रनटाइम पर एल्गोरिदम चुनने का पैटर्न)
cards.exampleSentence: The strategy pattern selects the parser per vendor.

cards.definition: A component that creates objects without exposing the logic (वस्तुएँ बनाने वाला घटक)
cards.exampleSentence: A factory returns the right parser for each file type.

cards.definition: A design where objects are notified of changes (परिवर्तन की सूचना पाने वाला पैटर्न)
cards.exampleSentence: The observer pattern notifies subscribers of price updates.

cards.definition: Designing software around the business domain (व्यावसायिक क्षेत्र केंद्रित डिज़ाइन)
cards.exampleSentence: Domain-driven design helped align code with business terms.

cards.definition: A boundary within which a domain model applies (एक मॉडल का सीमित दायरा)
cards.exampleSentence: Each bounded context owns its definition of an instrument.

cards.definition: Shared vocabulary between developers and business (साझा शब्दावली)
cards.exampleSentence: We agreed on a ubiquitous language for pricing terms.

cards.definition: A cluster of related objects treated as a unit (संबंधित वस्तुओं का समूह)
cards.exampleSentence: The order is the aggregate root for its line items.

cards.definition: Separating read and write models of a system (पढ़ने व लिखने के मॉडल का पृथक्करण)
cards.exampleSentence: CQRS lets us optimise queries independently of writes.

cards.definition: Storing state as a sequence of events (घटनाओं के क्रम के रूप में स्थिति सहेजना)
cards.exampleSentence: Event sourcing gives us a complete audit history.

cards.definition: A sequence of local transactions coordinated across services (वितरित लेन-देन की शृंखला)
cards.exampleSentence: A saga handles the multi-step booking process.

cards.definition: Services coordinating through events without a central controller (बिना केंद्रीय नियंत्रक के समन्वय)
cards.exampleSentence: Choreography reduces central coupling but is harder to trace.

cards.definition: Repeatedly checking for new data (बार-बार जाँचना)
cards.exampleSentence: Polling every second wastes resources.

cards.definition: A callback sent automatically when an event occurs (घटना होने पर स्वचालित सूचना कॉल)
cards.exampleSentence: The vendor calls our webhook when a file is ready.

cards.definition: Taking a significant time to complete (लंबे समय तक चलने वाला)
cards.exampleSentence: Long-running jobs should checkpoint their progress.

cards.definition: A saved state from which processing can resume (पुनः आरंभ योग्य सहेजा गया बिंदु)
cards.exampleSentence: The job resumes from its last checkpoint after a crash.

cards.definition: To process past events again (पिछली घटनाओं को दोबारा चलाना)
cards.exampleSentence: We replayed yesterday's messages to fix the totals.

cards.definition: To fill in missing historical data (छूटे हुए पुराने डेटा को भरना)
cards.exampleSentence: We backfilled three months of corrected prices.

cards.definition: To run data through processing again (डेटा को दोबारा प्रसंस्कृत करना)
cards.exampleSentence: Reprocess the failed files once the bug is fixed.

cards.definition: To remove duplicate records (दोहराए गए रिकॉर्ड हटाना)
cards.exampleSentence: We dedupe on vendor ID and timestamp.

cards.definition: A marker indicating how far processing has progressed (प्रसंस्करण की प्रगति का चिह्न)
cards.exampleSentence: Late events arrive after the watermark has passed.

cards.definition: Grouping streaming data into time-based chunks (समय-आधारित खंडों में बाँटना)
cards.exampleSentence: Windowing computes totals every five minutes.

cards.definition: An assurance that messages are processed in sequence (क्रम बनाए रखने की गारंटी)
cards.exampleSentence: Kafka only provides an ordering guarantee within a partition.

cards.definition: Routing a user's requests to the same server (एक ही सर्वर पर अनुरोध भेजना)
cards.exampleSentence: Sticky sessions complicate horizontal scaling.

cards.definition: Switching traffic between two identical environments (दो समान वातावरणों में स्विच करने वाली तैनाती)
cards.exampleSentence: Blue-green deployment gave us a zero-downtime release.

cards.definition: Gradually replacing instances with a new version (धीरे-धीरे नया संस्करण लगाना)
cards.exampleSentence: A rolling update keeps the service available throughout.

cards.definition: Settings that control how a system behaves (सेटिंग्स का समूह)
cards.exampleSentence: Keep configuration separate from code.

cards.definition: Securely storing and controlling sensitive credentials (गोपनीय क्रेडेंशियल्स का सुरक्षित प्रबंधन)
cards.exampleSentence: Secrets management prevents passwords leaking into repositories.

cards.definition: Following a request across multiple services (अनुरोध का सेवाओं के बीच अनुसरण)
cards.exampleSentence: Distributed tracing found the slow downstream call.

cards.definition: A unique identifier linking related log entries (संबंधित लॉग जोड़ने वाली पहचान)
cards.exampleSentence: Include a correlation ID in every log line.

cards.definition: Logging in a consistent machine-readable format (मशीन-पठनीय एकरूप लॉगिंग)
cards.exampleSentence: Structured logging makes searching much easier.

cards.definition: A target level of service reliability (सेवा विश्वसनीयता का लक्ष्य)
cards.exampleSentence: Our SLO is 99.9 percent of files processed within an hour.

cards.definition: The permitted amount of failure within an SLO (अनुमत विफलता की सीमा)
cards.exampleSentence: We have used most of our error budget this month.

cards.definition: Repetitive manual operational work that can be automated (दोहराया जाने वाला हाथ का परिचालन कार्य)
cards.exampleSentence: Reducing toil frees the team for engineering work.

cards.definition: Deliberately injecting failures to test resilience (जानबूझकर विफलताएँ डालकर परीक्षण)
cards.exampleSentence: Chaos engineering exposed a hidden dependency.

cards.definition: Plans and processes to restore systems after a major failure (आपदा के बाद पुनर्स्थापना योजना)
cards.exampleSentence: Our disaster recovery plan targets a two-hour recovery.

cards.definition: The maximum acceptable amount of data loss measured in time (अधिकतम स्वीकार्य डेटा हानि समय)
cards.exampleSentence: An RPO of fifteen minutes means losing at most fifteen minutes of data.

cards.definition: The maximum acceptable time to restore service (सेवा बहाली की अधिकतम समय-सीमा)
cards.exampleSentence: The RTO for this service is one hour.

cards.definition: Managing changes to an API using version numbers (एपीआई संस्करण प्रबंधन)
cards.exampleSentence: API versioning prevents breaking existing clients.

cards.definition: A change that stops existing users' code from working (पुराने उपयोगकर्ताओं को तोड़ने वाला बदलाव)
cards.exampleSentence: Removing the field is a breaking change.

cards.definition: A limit on how much data can be processed (डेटा प्रसंस्करण की गति में अवरोध)
cards.exampleSentence: The parser is the throughput bottleneck.

cards.definition: A reusable set of database connections (पुन: उपयोग योग्य कनेक्शनों का समूह)
cards.exampleSentence: The connection pool ran out under heavy load.

cards.definition: A set of reusable threads for executing tasks (कार्य करने वाले थ्रेड्स का समूह)
cards.exampleSentence: Tune the thread pool for CPU-bound work.

cards.definition: Memory that is never released after use (मेमोरी का न लौटना)
cards.exampleSentence: A memory leak crashed the service every few days.

cards.definition: Automatic reclaiming of unused memory (अनुपयोगी मेमोरी की स्वचालित सफ़ाई)
cards.exampleSentence: Long garbage collection pauses hurt latency.

cards.definition: The most frequently executed part of code (सबसे अधिक चलने वाला कोड भाग)
cards.exampleSentence: Avoid allocations on the hot path.

cards.definition: A part of a system under heavy use or load (सबसे अधिक भार वाला हिस्सा)
cards.exampleSentence: One partition became a hot spot.

cards.definition: Uneven distribution of data across partitions (डेटा का असमान वितरण)
cards.exampleSentence: Data skew caused one worker to lag.

cards.definition: The number of distinct values in a data set (अलग-अलग मानों की संख्या)
cards.exampleSentence: High cardinality makes this index expensive.

cards.definition: Loading data only when it is needed (ज़रूरत पड़ने पर ही डेटा लोड करना)
cards.exampleSentence: Lazy loading improved start-up time.

cards.definition: Loading related data in advance (संबंधित डेटा पहले से लोड करना)
cards.exampleSentence: Eager loading avoids repeated queries.

cards.definition: Failure to close connections after use (कनेक्शन बंद न करना)
cards.exampleSentence: A connection leak exhausted the database limit.

cards.definition: Rough and quick, as if calculated informally (मोटा और त्वरित अनुमान)
cards.exampleSentence: A back-of-the-envelope estimate shows ten terabytes a year.

cards.definition: The minimum number of nodes needed to agree (सहमति के लिए न्यूनतम सदस्य संख्या)
cards.exampleSentence: A write needs a quorum to succeed.

cards.definition: A process to choose one node to coordinate others (समन्वयक नोड चुनने की प्रक्रिया)
cards.exampleSentence: Leader election takes a few seconds after failure.

cards.definition: A fault where two parts of a system act independently (दो हिस्सों का स्वतंत्र काम करना)
cards.exampleSentence: A network partition caused a split brain.

cards.definition: A method for nodes to agree on a value (नोड्स में सहमति का तरीका)
cards.exampleSentence: Raft is a widely used consensus protocol.

cards.definition: A method where nodes spread information to peers (नोड्स द्वारा जानकारी फैलाने की विधि)
cards.exampleSentence: The cluster uses a gossip protocol for membership.

cards.definition: Strong dependence between components (घटकों की कसकर निर्भरता)
cards.exampleSentence: Tight coupling made the release risky.

cards.definition: Weak dependence allowing independent change (घटकों की ढीली निर्भरता)
cards.exampleSentence: Loose coupling lets teams deploy independently.

cards.definition: Making too many small network calls (ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा छोटे कॉल करने वाला)
cards.exampleSentence: The chatty API slowed the page load.

cards.definition: Sending one request to many downstream recipients (एक अनुरोध का कई जगह जाना)
cards.exampleSentence: Fan-out to ten services increased latency.

cards.definition: Combining many inputs into one (कई इनपुट का एक में मिलना)
cards.exampleSentence: Fan-in aggregates results from all vendors.

cards.definition: A helper container deployed alongside the main service (मुख्य सेवा के साथ चलने वाला सहायक कंटेनर)
cards.exampleSentence: A sidecar handles logging and security.

cards.definition: A server that forwards client requests to backend servers (अनुरोध आगे भेजने वाला सर्वर)
cards.exampleSentence: The reverse proxy terminates TLS.

cards.definition: A network of servers that delivers content from nearby locations (पास के सर्वर से सामग्री पहुँचाने वाला नेटवर्क)
cards.exampleSentence: A content delivery network cut page load time.

cards.definition: Low-cost storage for rarely accessed data (कम उपयोग वाले डेटा का सस्ता भंडारण)
cards.exampleSentence: Old files move to cold storage after ninety days.

cards.definition: Fast storage for frequently accessed data (बार-बार उपयोग वाले डेटा का तेज़ भंडारण)
cards.exampleSentence: Recent prices stay in hot storage.

cards.definition: Rules for how long data is kept (डेटा रखने की अवधि संबंधी नियम)
cards.exampleSentence: Our retention policy keeps raw files for seven years.

cards.definition: The requirement to store data in a particular region (डेटा का निर्धारित क्षेत्र में रहना)
cards.exampleSentence: Data residency rules limit where we host.

cards.definition: Replacing sensitive data with non-sensitive tokens (संवेदनशील डेटा को टोकन से बदलना)
cards.exampleSentence: Tokenisation protects client account numbers.

cards.definition: Hiding parts of sensitive data (संवेदनशील डेटा छुपाना)
cards.exampleSentence: Masking prevents leaks in test environments.

cards.definition: Removing personal identifiers from data (व्यक्तिगत पहचान हटाना)
cards.exampleSentence: Anonymisation is required before sharing datasets.

cards.definition: A security model that verifies every request (हर अनुरोध की पुष्टि करने वाला सुरक्षा मॉडल)
cards.exampleSentence: Zero trust assumes no network is safe.

cards.definition: The boundary of a protected network (सुरक्षित नेटवर्क की सीमा)
cards.exampleSentence: Security can't rely only on the perimeter.

cards.definition: Authorised simulated attacks to find weaknesses (अधिकृत नकली हमलों से कमज़ोरियाँ खोजना)
cards.exampleSentence: Penetration testing uncovered an exposed endpoint.

cards.definition: A structured analysis of possible attacks (संभावित हमलों का विश्लेषण)
cards.exampleSentence: We built a threat model for the new service.

cards.definition: Regularly replacing encryption keys (एन्क्रिप्शन कुंजियाँ नियमित बदलना)
cards.exampleSentence: Automatic key rotation reduced our risk.

cards.definition: Design that behaves as users expect (उपयोगकर्ता की अपेक्षा अनुसार व्यवहार)
cards.exampleSentence: An API should follow the principle of least astonishment.

cards.definition: Using sensible defaults to reduce setup (सरल डिफ़ॉल्ट से सेटअप घटाना)
cards.exampleSentence: Spring Boot favours convention over configuration.

cards.definition: Describing what is wanted rather than how to do it (क्या चाहिए बताने वाला (कैसे नहीं))
cards.exampleSentence: Terraform uses a declarative style.

cards.definition: Describing step-by-step how to do something (कदम-दर-कदम निर्देश देने वाला)
cards.exampleSentence: The old script was imperative and hard to follow.
